hero.title: Growing Prosperity through Cultural Intelligence (CQ®)
hero.body: Prynia Partners guides institutions and individuals through cultural advisory, leadership training, and international engagement. Whether you are working in a diverse setting, experiencing an international transition, or navigating a system transformation, we can help you.

reasons: 1st and only CQ® certified in Africa; 2nd in MENA and GCC
Consultants, trainers and facilitators are seasoned professionals with lived experience amplifying their expertise
Approach is human-centred across our services

growthStats.description: A snapshot of our impact so far.

ceo.name: Narjess Hachena
ceo.description: Narjess Hachena is Co-Founder of Prynia Partners and intercultural communication consultant with 11+ years of international experience in public diplomacy, education, culture, program development and economic empowerment. She has designed multiple initiatives funded by international donors, managed six-figure grant projects, and advised institutions and professionals internationally on strategy, innovation and prosperity. As a CQ® Certified Facilitator and Educator, Narjess helps organizations and individuals navigate transitions, increase effectiveness, and drive innovation through cultural intelligence.

members.name: Hind Houas
members.description: Hind Houas is Principal Consultant at Prynia Partners, bringing over 14 years of international experience in organizational development, strategic planning, governance, education, and stakeholder engagement. Hind has led complex, multimillion-dollar initiatives funded by international donors and advised governments, universities, NGOs, and private sector organizations on strategy, institutional strengthening, and sustainable growth. Drawing on both executive leadership and academic expertise, Hind helps clients navigate complexity, build organizational capacity, and design practical, evidence-based solutions that deliver lasting impact.

services.title: Services
description: Powered by Cultural Intelligence, our solutions help you navigate complexity, strengthen relationships, and create meaningful impact. Being effective is important. Thriving is transformational.

list.title: Cultural Advisory
list.description: We help individuals and organizations act with confidence through:
items: Expert debriefs for Cultural Intelligence (CQ®) assessments
Action plans for individuals operating in intercultural environments
Customized consultation services for community engagement projects operating in diverse settings or systems

list.title: Leadership Trainings
list.description: Our leadership programs are designed for institutional leaders operating across cultures and systems, building the judgment and communication needed to lead through uncertainty. This is your differentiator in the age of AI.

list.title: International Engagement
list.description: We design, facilitate and deliver engagement programs that align organizations and communities around a shared strategic direction. Workshop series, speaking engagements and book tours are among the few examples we’ve previously delivered.
